gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-batak: Pixel-blocky letters spaced far apart give Press Start 2P its game-cabinet grin. Noto Sans Batak sits underneath as a plain sans with a towering x-height, best left for the big, short lines up top to the heading.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Chunky retro pixels, spaced out like pinned cut-outs, set the tone in Press Start 2P. And Noto Sans Bengali follows as a plain sans with barely taller capitals and open mouths, so a long passage moves along without any fuss.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuk: That wide-spaced, arcade-cabinet look belongs to Press Start 2P alone. Shrink it down and its charm gets cramped, while Noto Sans Bhaiksuki, a sans-serif with swollen lowercase and open apertures, would feel oddly lost if enlarged.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Press Start 2P brings a gentle gradient of weight to its rounded, playful retro strokes, with big open lowercase bowls. Noto Sans Brahmi tucks in beneath, its mean line set high.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P spaces its letters far apart with only moderate contrast in the strokes. Noto Sans Buginese then takes over as a sans-serif with open letter mouths and short ascenders, giving the page a modern, quieter counterpart.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid has a high-set x-height and generous gaps between curve ends and stems. Over a long stretch, Noto Sans Buhid reads as a modern sans that never feels crowded, while Press Start 2P above it stays fun and retro.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-carian: Fun, pixel-spaced retro lettering with a slight swell on its bowls is what Press Start 2P brings. But Noto Sans Carian handles the quieter work as a clean sans, its terminals held apart like open scissor blades.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Press Start 2P looks like a stone-carved inscription reimagined as a retro arcade game, its weight shifting just slightly. Noto Sans Chakma, a plain sans, is the friendly, uncrowded counterweight.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-cham: Those big, open-looking lowercase bowls and pinned-apart spacing make Press Start 2P instantly retro. Noto Sans Cham follows as a plain sans with tall rounded forms and generous c openings, keeping the page modern and clean beneath the fun.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee sets a tall band of letters under short stalks, with an e that gapes wide at its terminal. And Press Start 2P, fun and retro with softly shifting curves, gives it a playful head, while the sans below keeps a long passage approachable.
